input.summary:
Yaba Market Store, Dry Goods shelf (audit confidence 0.92, trustworthy; 100% planogram share, no unknown products). 2 of 5 planogram SKUs were stocked out.

Actions:
1. Indomie Chicken 70g (0 facings observed, expected 3) - store already holds 9 units, above its reorder point of 6. This is a SHELF REFILL, not an order. No purchase order raised; manager asked to restock the slot from back stock.
2. Golden Penny Spaghetti 500g (0 facings observed, expected 4) - only 4 units on hand vs reorder point 6, so both out on shelf and at/below reorder point. Proposed reorder of 2 cases (24 units, case size 12) to cover 4 facings x 3 = 12 units plus the reorder point of 6. Estimated cost 2,280,000 kobo (~N22,800).
3. Fridge fault: telemetry shows the unit above 8C for 40 minutes with a peak of 11.2C, and auditor notes flag a fault. Proposed a high-urgency technician dispatch (est. 1,500,000 kobo) and told the manager to check chilled stock for spoilage.
4. Notified the manager by WhatsApp covering the two stock-outs, the refill instruction, the reorder, and the fridge dispatch.

The remaining three SKUs (Indomie Onion Chicken 120g, Dangote Spaghetti 500g, Golden Penny Semovita 1kg) are at expected facings; no action needed.
